## Install / Download

**New to Unbored? Get the Companion app instead of this zip.** The Unbored Companion for Windows puts Wisp into the game for you and keeps her up to date. Download it from the [newest Companion release](https://github.com/hmbanan666/wow-unbored/releases?q=companion&expanded=true) (the file ending in `-setup.exe`), or follow the [three-step install in the README](https://github.com/hmbanan666/wow-unbored#install).

**Installing the addon by hand** (no Companion, or not on Windows):

1. Download **Unbored-v{{VERSION}}.zip** below.
2. Unzip it into `World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns/`, so there is an `Unbored` folder inside.
3. Start the game. Wisp appears on the left of your screen; click her.

Without the Companion, Wisp still makes quick plans, adds tips to item tooltips and answers common questions. Fuller answers and full plans need the Companion.

<sub>`release.json` is for addon managers. You can ignore it.</sub>
